question: What measure is assigned to the middle of the shank in relation to the nalaka extent?
premises: The reference involves the nalaka extent.
The measured location is the middle of the shank.
The assigned measure is six aṅgulas.
inference: The middle of the shank is measured as six aṅgulas in that relation.
uncertainties: The technical meaning of nalakātatiyedāṃśaṃ is uncertain.
plain_english: In relation to the nalaka extent, the middle of the shank is six aṅgulas.
